author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Generic exhaustiveness helper reports every unhandled value as a Library mode.
findings.consequence: If runtime API data reaches an exhaustive default outside mode switches, diagnostics misidentify the failed discriminator and collapse objects to [object Object], making backend contract drift harder to trace.
findings.evidence: The exported helper throws `Unhandled Library mode` for any never value, while direct callers include all-item and search-response exhaustiveness checks in app/lib/library/view-model.ts as well as mode checks in app/lib/library/index.ts.
findings.recommendation: Make the helper message neutral, for example `Unhandled Library value: ${JSON.stringify(value)}` with a safe fallback, or accept a context label from each caller.
verification: Inspected app/lib/library/index.ts owned lines 44-46 and surrounding request builders.
Inspected direct callers in app/lib/library/view-model.ts, app/lib/library/component-models.ts, app/lib/library/filter-options.ts, and app/pages/bibliotek.vue.
Inspected generated type boundaries in app/lib/api/generated/lbapi.ts for library request and response unions.
Used read-only commands only: sed, nl, rg, and git status.
Did not run tests because the review request required read-only commands and the named test file was inspected directly.
Confirmed assertNever is a small exported exhaustiveness helper used by mode, item, and response switches.
No unresolved critical or important findings were identified.
